svg.aria-label: Domain and email. Public domain rayanaldossary.com: registrar Cloudflare, DNS on Cloudflare, email on Google Workspace. Internal domain swagger.rayanaldossary.com, a subdomain of it: DNS served by Active Directory on DC-01 and DC-02, resolves only inside the lab, and every Windows machine is a member. Mail DNS records on Cloudflare: MX at @: smtp.google.com · priority 10, Routes mail to Google Workspace; TXT at @: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all, SPF: only Google may send as the domain; TXT at google._domainkey: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=… (Google key), DKIM: signs every outgoing message; TXT at _dmarc: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:rayan@…, DMARC: monitors and reports spoofing; TXT at @: google-site-verification=…, Proves domain ownership to Google.
svg.title: Domain and email
